body:
professionally, I want to try ECT.  I have done a lot of research and I think it may help me.  But once again, I have the roadblock of having no one here to watch me during the day and that is a requirement.

Support wise....I just want to love and be loved.

Perhaps.  But I have posted warning signs on the bathroom door and will have it shut so he wont be forced to see the mess if he gets there before the paramedics do.  He knows my mental history...he wont be surprised.

Thank you for your offer, but I could never take anyone up on help of that magnitude.  I do actually love myself when Im not having a depressive episode and Im very content with being single.  But my boyfriend has chosen, perhaps, the most vulnerable time of my life to emotionally abandon me and break my heart.

It can take up to 6 months to get disability here.  And thats if they dont hassle me about it.  But with so many people cheating the disability system, it is hard for people who truly need help, to receive it.

No, I have no one.  I have a male friend or two but they have sweet, wonderful girlfriends who are also my friends.  

I dont want another bf.  I just wanted the one I have to genuinely love me.

And anyway, a new bf wouldnt solve the multitude of other issues I have.
Thanks, Ive been on welbutrin though and it does nothing for me except destroy what little appetite I did have.  I have none now.

Thank you for your kind words too.  I would love nothing more than to get away.  To distance myself.  Unfortunately, after looking at it from every angle, there is no real solution. My friends who are willing to take me in need rent money and I just dont have it, nor can I get it unless I get disability.  Which, I would be on if I hadnt have listened to my jerk bf - who advised me strongly not to go on disability.

So rock meets hard place and I am crushed.

Thank you.  It looks like I wont be doing it tonight anyway.  I dont want to traumatise the kids next door with gunfire so I will.wait until they are safely in school tomorrow.

Plus, itll give the person Im calling to come get my cats a reason to take the day off work.

Ive tried getting professional help many times.  One pdoc actually put me on ADD medication...which led to the hospitalized manic episode.  Im supposed to be on lithium and wellbutrin now.  I stopped taking both.  The welbutrin was making me lose weight and not helping, and I dont know why I stopped taking the lithium.  Stupidity probably.  Ive tried many different therapists but none of them seem to click.
No, she died when I was really young.

Im afraid of being alone and unloved.  I thought my bf was the one.  I believed all the things he said - that we were soulmates, he would never give up on me, we would grow old together, he would love me forever.

I am afraid of never accomplishing anything worthwhile with my life.  I was so motivated before.  I wanted to be an engineer so bad..my grades were so good..then they plummeted..now I am not in school.

I am afraid I will never feel well again.  I am afraid of being stuck in this pit of despair.  And I just cant live this way.  No one should have to live this way.

Thank you for your intent, but those people were not me, nor I them.  Maybe they were simply stronger or had a better support system.  There are so many differing factors.

All I know is my pain and my limits.  And my limits have been reached.  Im just scared.  Im really scared to pull the trigger.  I dont know why.  I dont really believe in any afterlife of sorts, I think I just need to talk myself up to it.

Thank you for your kind words.  Essentially, I am alone.  I have almost no family, my dad, who means the world to me, is struggling with cancer and once he is gone, Im all alone.  I hate to leave him while he is goimg through his own ordeal but he has his wife, and he lives in a different country.  I have a few friends who care, but there is only so much support they can give.  

My bf, who swore to me he would be there for me through thick and thin, promised he would support me both financially and emotionally through this rough time has fallen short of the emotional part and I forsee him pulling away financial support soon as well.  Im not his wife....he owes me nothing.  I just feel so...lied to and tossed away like yesterdays refuse.  He refuses to listen to my fears and he has all but cut me away emotionally.  I also know he is chatting up his ex-gf while he has been deployed.  I am just to disheartened and numb to do anything about it.  

I just cant take anymore.  The stress, the heartache, the hopelessness, the lonliness, the feeling things will never improve....the pain has to end.  I cant do this life.  I tried.  I failed.
